text:
sarah: Heads-up — after yesterday's VPC egress hardening some warm-pool nodes in eu-west-1 are failing to finish provisioning. ~12/50 GPUs stuck in init with KMS errors.
ajay: seeing the same in ap-south-1. bootstrap logs: `ERROR: KMSAccessDenied: AccessDenied` and repeated retries.
liam: firewall rule change that went out was `egress: deny 0.0.0.0/0` except a small allowlist. Who rolled that?
infra-bot: Deploy approved by @michael at 3334440000 (policy-change/vpc-egress-tighten).
michael: that was my change. security asked to lockdown ephemeral NATs. I missed adding KMS + logging S3 endpoints to the allowlist — my bad.
sarah: we need a fast rollback plan. Warm pool churn is causing cost and capacity pain. Also retry storms are spiking our S3 PUTs (audit logs).
ajay: immediate mitigations I suggest: 1) open egress to regional KMS endpoints and S3 logging sinks; 2) add a temporary security group allowing only KMS/S3; 3) client-side throttling for failed decrypts.
liam: +1. Alternatively, provision a Privatelink for KMS in the region — less blast radius but ~4h to configure and propagate DNS.
oncall-rot: can the warm pool nodes be moved to a NAT with looser egress as a quickfix? I can stand up an alt NAT in eu-west-1.
michael: please do that in parallel. I'll patch the egress ACLs to include `kms.*.amazonaws.com` and `s3.*.amazonaws.com` for eu-west-1 and ap-south-1.
ajay: also, audit logs are surging because of repeated decrypt retries. Our S3 PUT rate is ~1200/s right now — rough estimate +$800/day if sustained. We should throttle retries immediately.
sarah: can we push a small keystore client change to add exponential backoff on decrypt attempts? e.g. `for attempt in 1..5 sleep(2**attempt)` and return a temporary failure instead of hammering KMS.
michael: will open a PR for the backoff and a hotfix for the allowlist.
liam: propose k8s node health tweak: mark node NotReady after 10 failed boots so we stop endless reprovision churn and let capacity autoscaler handle replacements.
oncall-rot: I'll patch kube-probe on the warm pool DaemonSet as a canary.
ajay: rolling canary plan: push backoff + health tweak to staging; patch egress allowlist in infra as a guarded change; if staging looks good, rollback the global deny and apply regional allow instead.
sarah: IAM snippet we applied for KMS allow — keep it scoped to region/account: `{"Effect":"Allow","Action":["kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],"Resource":"arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:123456789012:key/*"}`. Keep only required ARNs.
liam: long-term items: 1) add preflight simulation to PRs that modify egress (simulate keystore calls), 2) create a managed allowlist for platform services (KMS, S3, STS), 3) evaluate Privatelink for KMS in critical regions.
michael: apologies again. Action items: I) patch infra allowlist (michael) II) stand up alt NAT for warm pool (oncall-rot) III) push client backoff + kube fix (ajay) IV) cost/runbook note for audit spike (sarah).
sarah: thanks — I'll own the incident doc and cost calc. tagging for visibility: @eng-sre @eng-security :eyes: :thumbsup:
